# Pro Floor Installers

> Professional flooring installation services in Toronto, Ontario, Canada.

Pro Floor Installers provides flooring installation services for residential and commercial properties in Toronto and surrounding areas.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://www.pro-floor-installers.com/): Overview of flooring services and completed projects.
- [About Us](https://www.pro-floor-installers.com/about/): Company information, flooring expertise, materials and installation techniques.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.pro-floor-installers.com/diverse/): Information about services, service areas and how to request a consultation.

## Flooring Services

- [Hardwood Flooring](https://www.pro-floor-installers.com/hardwood-flooring/): Hardwood flooring solutions.
- [Laminate Flooring](https://www.pro-floor-installers.com/laminate-flooring/): Laminate flooring installation.
- [Vinyl Flooring](https://www.pro-floor-installers.com/vinyl-flooring/): Vinyl flooring installation.

## Installation and Projects

The website features flooring projects and information about installation methods, including parquet patterns such as herringbone and chevron, vinyl flooring, laminate flooring and staircase projects.

Visit the main website for project examples and further information.

## Service Area

Toronto, Ontario, Canada, and surrounding areas. Contact the company to confirm service availability for a specific location.
